Appendix H
Student Rating Measurement Specication
The external human measure is the full published NMLS (Koc & Barut,
2016). Its agent-administered form is an exploratory synthetic diagnostic, not the
primary computational outcome or a validated measure of agent competence. Ad-
ministration uses its authorised item wording and ve-point agreement anchors, not
paraphrases of the domain descriptions in this thesis. This appendix provides the
scoring map, not a replacement administration form. A translated or shortened
instrument has a separate version identity and cannot inherit validity merely by
retaining the NMLS name.
